translations.web: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.
translations.bsb: And you have declared this day how you have treated me well, for when the LORD delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.
translations.kjv: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
translations.asv: And thou hast declared this day how that thou hast dealt well with me, forasmuch as when Jehovah had delivered me up into thy hand, thou killedst me not.
